newsitem.title: UK: Abbey extends gain on mortgage rise.
newsitem.headline: Abbey extends gain on mortgage rise.

text.p: Shares in Abbey National Plc rose to a record high in early trading on Tuesday amid hopes for a profit boost from the decision yesterday to raise mortgage rates, traders said.

Abbey was marked 5-1/2p higher to a record 714-1/4 by 0811 GMT, while other banks were also higher with Lloyds TSB Group Plc up 3p at 422-1/2, Barclays Plc up 2p at 10.13-1/2 stg and National Westminster Bank Plc up 2-1/2p at 690-1/2.
A report in the Times newspaper said Abbey's move was "more to do with widening margins and raising profits" than lifting returns to savers.
